name: DeepResearchEval
intro: DeepResearchEval是一个针对深度研究系统的自动化评测框架。它采用角色驱动的流程来生成复杂的真实研究任务，这些任务需要整合多个来源的证据并进行外部检索。该框架包含一个自适应的单点质量评估机制，能根据每个任务动态调整评估维度、标准和权重，同时还具备主动事实核查功能，即使在没有引文的情况下也能通过网络搜索自主验证报告内容的准确性。
org: Infinity Lab, Shanda Group; Nanyang Technological University
build_method: 角色驱动大模型生成, 双重自动过滤, 博士专家验证
metric: 自适应加权质量分, 正确陈述占比, 维度与标准级分数
eval_feature: 可刷新动态任务, 无参考自适应评分, 引用与无引用陈述主动核查
build_method_en: Persona-driven LLM Generation, Two-stage Automated Filtering, PhD-expert Verification
eval_feature_en: Refreshable Live Tasks, Reference-free Adaptive Scoring, Active Checking of Cited and Uncited Claims
intro_en: DeepResearchEval is an automated evaluation framework for deep research systems. It uses a role-driven process to generate complex, real-world research tasks that require integrating evidence from multiple sources and performing external retrieval. The framework includes an adaptive single-point quality assessment mechanism that dynamically adjusts evaluation dimensions, criteria, and weights for each task. It also features proactive fact-checking, enabling autonomous verification of report accuracy via web search even without citations.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.09688, especially Figures 2 and 4 and Sections 3-4. The pipeline generates 50 personas across 10 domains, creates four tasks per persona (200 candidates), retains candidates above 0.7 on four qualification criteria, and removes tasks that a no-search parametric baseline can answer well, leaving 155. Seven PhD experts verify and rank the retained set; 80% receive approval from at least four experts, and the top 100 become the evaluated English task set. Adaptive point-wise quality evaluation combines four general dimensions with generated task-specific dimensions and normalized dimension/criterion weights on 1-10 judgments. Active fact-checking segments reports, extracts cited and uncited verifiable claims, retrieves evidence through MCP tools, labels claims Right/Wrong/Unknown, and reports the Right-to-all-statements ratio.
